{{Version|2.2.23|}}
[[File:Contracts Button.png|frameless|left]]Contracts are unlocked at [[Obelisk]] level 12. Contract upgrades are not permanent; they will reset on [[Prestige]].

Contracts require bars to complete. Completing more contracts increases the difficulty and number of bars required. Each contract completed will award you 10 {{Sprite|Contract Point||20|Contract Points}} by default. Contract points can be used to purchase upgrades, which get more expensive per upgrade purchased. Contracts start asking for World 2 bars after you've completed 2500 and World 3 bars after 5000.

{{Clear|left}}
==Contract upgrades==
{{See also|Stats#Contracts}}
Various upgrades are available to increase  {{Sprite|Contract Point||20|Contract Points}} gain and decrease expenditure:
*[[Stats#tabber-Contract_Cost_Reduction|Contract Cost Reduction]] - Reduces the amount of bars required to complete Contracts up to 50,000% (reduces requirement to ~0.2% of the base value)
*[[Stats#tabber-Double_Contract_Point_Chance|Double Contract Point Chance]] - Increases a chance to obtain 2x the amount of Contract Points from completing a Contract
*[[Stats#tabber-Triple_Contract_Point_Chance|Triple Contract Point Chance]] - Increases a chance to obtain 3x the amount of Contract Points from completing a Contract
*[[Stats#tabber-5x_Contract_Point_Chance|5x Contract Point Chance]] - Increases a chance to obtain 5x the amount of Contract Points from completing a Contract
*[[Stats#tabber-10x_Contract_Point_Chance|10x Contract Point Chance]] - Increases a chance to obtain 10x the amount of Contract Points from completing a Contract
*[[Stats#tabber-Contract_Points_Rewarded|Contract Points Rewarded]] - Increases the base amount of Contract Points received from completing a Contract (base 10)
*[[Stats#tabber-Contract_Upgrade_Cap_Increase|Contract Upgrade Cap Increase]] - Increases the base cap of all Contract [[Contracts#Upgrades|Upgrades]]
*[[Stats#tabber-Contract_Upgrade_Cost_Reduction|Contract Upgrade Cost Reduction]] - Reduces the amount of Contract Points needed to purchase an  [[Contracts#Upgrades|Upgrade]]

==Contracts Refund==
The "[[Skill-Tree#Skills|Who's Asking For All These Bars?]]" and "[[Skill-Tree#Skills|Please Sir Don't Make Me Prestige Again]]" skills provide contract point re-specs. They allow the option to reset contract upgrades and refund spent contract points to reallocate as desired. The former provides 1 re-spec total, and the latter provides 1 re-spec per level up to 3.

==Trivia==
*There used to be an upgrade that would reduce the contract bar requirement by 40% which was available at [[Prestige#Tier 3 Artifacts|Prestige Tier 3]]. This was removed in the relic overhaul update in favor of the rare relics that perform a similar function described above. The artifact was replaced by a bomb capacity upgrade.
